note: A pass carrying both `turn` and `pinned` (SPEC 3.3.3). A turn already fixes the pass, so a pin on it states nothing and a writer that emits one has two answers for what the user fixed. The chain is dropped and the diagnostic names the pass, since the fault is the pair, not either key. Every other rule holds for this walk, so a reader that checks only connection and spelling reads it clean.

diagnostics.message_advisory: a pass with a turn is never pinned — the chain is dropped
